_about: Bildkarten (/wissen/bildwoerterbuch): the 100 most important German words as picture cards, like a children's memory game but with nothing on the back. Chosen 2026-10-14 from the lexicon's frequency ranking (OpenSubtitles), skipping words without a clear picture (haben, sein, nicht, Zeit …) and people (things have no faces). 30 nouns, 20 verbs, 20 adjectives, 30 little words (adverbs and prepositions), each class ordered by frequency. `id` is the lexicon id: article, audio and translations come from there; the drawing from src/lib/bildwoerter.js (src/lib/bildkarten/). `merch`: the ten motifs on /merch (shirt, mug, postcard, gift card), picked for what sells on a mug, not by rank.
